description:
## Why
fixture_purposes.tsv (attached to fz-p8p) drafts a purpose for all 433 numbered files. Files no earlier step touched still need processing.

## What changes
Each remaining file gets its purpose, a `main` if it has none (92 files lack one), and moves to `fixtures/`. Misdescribing stems are renamed (00510, 00298, 00524, 00287); one of the two 00556 files is renumbered; exact duplicates merge; unreferenced 00011, 00012, 00028 are deleted unless a claim adopts them.

Three near-duplicate pairs already in `fixtures/` fold into their lower number (owner approved):
- 00248_make_resource_dtor ← 00354_make_resource_dtor
- 00249_aliased_resource_dtor ← 00355_aliased_resource_dtor
- 00250_two_distinct_resources ← 00356_two_distinct_resources

In each pair, the only difference is that the higher number calls `dbg(:before)` before the resource drops, so its golden gains a leading `:before` line. That makes it a strict superset, because it also proves the destructor runs after the program's other output. The lower file takes the `dbg(:before)` line, its golden and a purpose naming both claims. 00354–00356 and their sidecars are deleted, and every reference is repointed.

## Signal
No numbered .fz files are left directly in fixtures2/. Also, no two files in fixtures/ differ only by a `dbg` line.
title: Move the remaining numbered fixtures2 files to fixtures/
